# `set_img_file_info`

<!-- Generated by tools/gen_cards.py from catalog/. Do not edit by hand. -->

Write planet-stack sharpen values into a FITS file header.

## Summary

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| Kind | method (client sends) |
| Grade | MUTATOR / probable (64-bit build; 32-bit build probable) |
| Side-effect tier | C |
| Confidence | READ |
| Basis | static analysis of firmware 9.31, handler @0xe00b0, WriteFitsSharpen @0x69f440 (64-bit build); FITS open helper PHD_fits_open_diskfile (258, one branch 268), writeHeaderString (256), PHD_fits_close_file (256), jrpc_error with the thread-local err_code (finding #322) |

Opens the FITS file for update, writes the SHARPEN string key and closes it. If the matching thumbnail name resolves and the thumbnail is removed, the thumbnail is regenerated; a failure of that thumbnail step after the FITS write succeeded is logged and ignored. The reply carries the error code set by the FITS step: 258 when the file cannot be opened, 256 when the key cannot be written or the file cannot be closed (READ).

Side effects: Modifies FITS header metadata on disk and regenerates the thumbnail image.

## Errors

| Code | Trigger | Label |
|---|---|---|
| 107 | params absent, null or not an object | `expected object param` |
| 105 | file_name missing or not a string | `expected string param` |
| 102 | planet_stack_sharpen missing or not an array | `invalid params` |
| 104 | A sharpen element is not an integer | `expected int param` |
| 258 | FITS file cannot be opened for update | `open file failed` |
| 256 | SHARPEN key write fails, or the FITS file cannot be closed | `fit operation failed` |
| 268 | One internal open-failure path (condition INFERRED); 268 has no text, so the reply text is the fallback | `fail to operate` |
| 200 | Dispatcher: request has no id | `invalid id` |
| 100 | Dispatcher: method missing or not a string | `invalid request` |

## Example

Request, write - Values invented:

```json
{"id":95,"method":"set_img_file_info","params":{"file_name":"Example/Stacked_example.fit","planet_stack_sharpen":[3,5,2]}}
```

Reply, ok:

```json
{"jsonrpc":"2.0","Timestamp":"1234.123456789","method":"set_img_file_info","result":0,"code":0,"id":95}
```

Reply, bad-element:

```json
{"jsonrpc":"2.0","Timestamp":"1234.123456789","method":"set_img_file_info","error":"expected int param","code":104,"id":96}
```
